releaseNotes:
v2.26.0 — In-app review prompt, billing reliability & achievement fixes
• Added in-app review prompt after completing 10 non-timer levels
• Two-step dialog: asks if you enjoy the game then asks for a Play Store review
• Reward for reviewing: +5 lives, +1,000 coins, +10 diamonds
• Fixed billing retry: product details now re-fetched on reconnect and at startup
• Billing cache now cleared on disconnect to prevent stale purchase failures
• Achievements: verified all 31 real Play Console IDs are wired correctly
